title: The man with the violin who followed the band
summary: Valentine describes a man who followed the band and could tune a violin but not play, and the pranks done to him.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: But you know him? Now you see, now a lot of people, you know a lot of people ask me about him? They thought he could play. No, he couldn't play nothing. Now that man, you know what I mean, that man been following us for years and years and years and years. Well, we go to that man and follow us. Uh huh. And uh, but he can't play nothing. But one thing, he know how to tune that violin. He can tune it. Oh yeah, he can. He really can tune that violin up in the right pitch, you know what I'm talking about? But just play anything, he couldn't play nothing. That's funny. And sometimes, man he be sewing on that violin and he be making a squeak, that little squeaky noise, boy it gets you kind of, you know what I mean, upset. That little noise going into your ear, you know. So, you know, we all have to stop him from that, that, that, on that violin, you know what I mean? So, sometimes a white boy come up there, you know, you know something white boy, you know, do a lot of mischievous things, you know. You know what they do sometimes, sometimes a white boy come down and put, rub grease on his string. See if he rub grease on that bow, you can't, you can't saw. See? See, you can't do nothing without you rubbing grease on that, you see. Sometimes come and take and rub that bow in the hair. And you see, if you have grease in your hair, you see, because now that grease get on there, you can't saw nothing, you know what I mean? But I used to feel sorry for him. I'd be Mr. If somebody broke this violin, I'd be Mr. Bill, get him a violin. Mr. Bill went over there and brought him a violin and gave it to him.
